items.docs: Generate a model response from a list of messages comprising a conversation. Compatible with the OpenAI Chat Completions API, with support for streaming, tool calls, and structured outputs. Additionally, the model can utilize built-in tools for tool calls, enhancing its capability to provide more comprehensive and actionable responses.
